title: Morphing-BOT: Revolutionizing Global Infrastructure with AI-Powered Smart Inspection and Predictive Maintenance
summary: Morphing I reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of pipelines and produced validated inspection data. Avoided leaks and failures remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Morphing I reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of pipelines and produced validated inspection data. Avoided leaks and failures remain unmeasured. Municipal pilots / early commercialization. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Inspect inaccessible water pipelines and support predictive maintenance.
deployer: Municipal pilot partners in Jeju, Jindo, Jeonju, and Siheung
location: Jeju, Jindo, Jeonju, and Siheung, South Korea

ratings.reason: Municipal pilots reportedly inspected more than 30 km and generated independently validated inspection data. This supports improved inspection capability, without establishing avoided pipeline failures.
More reliable water service and fewer leaks are intended; public resource and safety effects are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 1: Morphing-BOT: Revolutionizing Global Infrastructure with AI-Powered Smart Inspection and Predictive Maintenance

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Multimodal sensors suitable for pipeline conditions
On-device processing where wireless communication is limited

headline: Morphing-BOT inspects water pipelines

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
